answer.description: The answer for the user, in Markdown. Base it only on tool results.

evidence.description: The metadata items from tool results that the answer relies on. Use the ids exactly as returned by the tools. Empty if no tool result was used.

type.description: SCHEMA (schemaId), TABLE (tableId), COLUMN (columnId), RELATION (relationId), TERM (termId), WORD (wordId), DOMAIN (domainId), HISTORY (historyId: one past change record), LOGICAL_MODEL (modelId), SUBJECT_AREA (subjectAreaId), LOGICAL_ENTITY (entityId), LOGICAL_ATTRIBUTE (attributeId), LOGICAL_IDENTIFIER (identifierId), LOGICAL_RELATIONSHIP (relationshipId), SUBTYPE_GROUP (groupId)

id.description: The id returned by the tool for this item

name.description: The name of the item as returned by the tool (table, column, relation, term, word, domain, logical model, subject area, entity, attribute, identifier, relationship or subtype group name)

tableId.description: COLUMN only: the tableId of the table the column belongs to

kind.description: RELATION only: FK (registered foreign key) or LOGICAL (model relation without a database constraint)

usesDescription.description: LOGICAL_ATTRIBUTE only: true if the answer relies on the attribute's description (returned with includeAttributeDescriptions)
